description: Store a reusable part made of 1 to 64 entities (shapes or lights) and get its k_ id. Each entity needs key (^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$) and may name parent, the key of another entity in the list; positions are in the composite's own space, with its origin on the ground. Then draw it any number of times with world_place and an entity of kind "instance" (see world_palette): one instance with repeat draws up to 16 copies in one call. A composite never changes and belongs to the room it was made in; every drawn copy counts toward your quota. A write: needs a token. Returns "created <k_ id>". Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_composite
